Lemma
[Fourier expansion of the Lobachevsky function] \group lobachevsky Source: thurston:page-0172

The Lobachevsky function has the uniformly convergent expansion \[ \Lambda (\theta )=\frac12\sum _{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{\sin (2n\theta )}{n^2}. \]
Proof

\sketch Take imaginary parts in the dilogarithm identity of the preceding definition. Uniform convergence extends the identity to the endpoints.

□
